rows.grounds: object of sprinkling continued from previous verse
instrument; bīja kept as seed-syllable per tradition
compound qualifying the seed-syllables as consisting of elements

items.question: What kinds of formulas empower the sprinkling water in this continued ritual action?
premises: The water is the object of the sprinkling action carried over from the previous verse.
The water is accompanied by mantras and by seed-syllables.
The seed-syllables are characterized as element-natured.
items.inference: Therefore, the sprinkling water is likewise empowered by mantras and by seed-syllables whose nature corresponds to the elements.
uncertainties: The specific mantras and element-natured seed-syllables are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Likewise, the water is empowered with mantras and with seed-syllables that are of the nature of the elements.
